conclusion: Do not adopt a Global Mod Broker protocol until live Teardown load-order and unload evidence exists.

scenarioDecisions.name: Content before Global
scenarioDecisions.reason: Broker cannot assume Core exists before Content registration.

scenarioDecisions.name: Global before Content
scenarioDecisions.reason: Dependency handshake and version pin are not observable.

scenarioDecisions.name: Core missing
scenarioDecisions.reason: Never load a package against a missing Core.

scenarioDecisions.name: Core version mismatch
scenarioDecisions.reason: Fail fast; never silently downgrade the package.

scenarioDecisions.name: Package unload
scenarioDecisions.reason: No proven unload callback for generated definitions/runtime instances.

scenarioDecisions.name: Multiplayer host/remote
scenarioDecisions.reason: Authority and replication order require live evidence.

scenarioDecisions.name: Multiple packages/conflict
scenarioDecisions.reason: Namespaced IDs can be sorted, but duplicate capability ownership needs Core policy.

rollback: Keep Broker disabled; remove experiment registration and leave Content/Global source-of-truth unchanged.
